items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Thomas Mack that was with us, with that show, Mary Mack? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] I remember that.

ctx.x: Jay McCobbs. My mother's mother died when she was born. She didn't know her mother. Well her grandmother was working for this year, Jay McCobbs. And she the one that was taking care of my mother when she was a little kid coming up. So they probably raised my mother. Yeah? They did.
Do you remember Thomas Mack that was with us, with that show, Mary Mack? Yeah.
